essence: The antagonist completes the no-self offensive by moving from things to their togetherness: where nothing genuinely relates, no one genuinely acts.
Relation is tried in every candidate shape — resting in both terms at once, expectation, adhesion, mere wording — and each shape breaks on the ground that what rests on two cannot be one.

Refutation itself gets its method fixed: not bare not-seeing, but a pointed-out impossibility inside the opponent's own admissions, holding only here-and-now unless the contradiction is made universal.
With knower, known, act and bond all set aside as built, the doer stands exposed as built too — the exact spot where the recognition teaching will later reverse the verdict.
